name: scene
description: Save and switch whole setups in one click: the apps, where every window sits on which display, the sites and files that open, volume, appearance and wallpaper, for work, gaming, match day or anything else.
author: Bilal

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Scene uses System Events to read, move and resize windows, and to change appearance and wallpaper when you switch scenes.
